## Word or phrase

What expression would you like UnslopText to highlight?

## Suggested alternatives

List plain-English alternatives and a short, safe example.

## Why it helps

Explain why the expression could be clearer, more direct or less repetitive.

Use an invented example or public quotation only. Do not include confidential text, personal information or private documents. GitHub issues are public, and UnslopText does not need the contents of your editor.
